name: My Gym Crush: Private Workout
source:
On his first evening at a new job, Alex—a former massage therapist and newly qualified trainer—is assigned an unusual client. Maria is beautiful, confident, and used to being watched. But behind her perfect form are pain, exhaustion, and a life built around the schedule of Daniel, her famous boxer boyfriend.

Maria needs a trainer who will not make every decision for her. Alex notices too much, speaks too honestly, and from their very first meeting makes her feel like more than an accessory standing beside a champion.

A routine movement assessment quickly becomes dangerous attraction. Private messages, personal photos, provocative bets, recovery massages, and meetings after closing time erase the professional distance between them. Daniel may appear at any moment, and one careless answer could expose everything.

But this is more than a forbidden affair. To grow closer to Maria, Alex must listen, respect her boundaries and safety signals, be honest about his intentions, and earn her trust through his actions. Maria must decide whether she is ready to stop living by someone else’s schedule and make a free choice of her own.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5041900/My_Gym_Crush_Private_Workout/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
入职新工作的第一个晚上，曾任按摩理疗师、刚考取教练资格的亚历克斯便分到了一位不同寻常的客户。玛丽亚美丽动人、自信大方，早已习惯了旁人注视的目光；但在她无可挑剔的身材背后，却藏着伤痛、疲惫，以及完全围着著名拳击手男友丹尼尔的日程表打转的生活。

玛丽亚需要的是一位不会替她包办一切决定的教练。而亚历克斯观察得太过细致，说话又太过坦率真诚，从初次见面的那一刻起，便让她觉得自己不再只是站在冠军身旁的花瓶配饰。

一次例行的体态与动作评估，很快演变成了危险的相互吸引。私密消息、私人自拍、挑逗意味十足的打赌、运动恢复按摩，以及打烊后的单独幽会，一点点抹去了两人之间的职业界限。丹尼尔随时可能现身，任何一句不慎失言都可能让一切彻底败露。

但这绝不仅仅是一场禁忌偷情。要想真正走近玛丽亚，亚历克斯必须学会倾听，尊重她的边界与安全信号，坦诚面对自己的心意，并用实际行动赢得她的信任；而玛丽亚也必须做出抉择——自己是否已准备好不再按别人的日程表生活，真正遵从本心做出自由的选择。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5041900/My_Gym_Crush_Private_Workout/]Steam[/url]]
